name: Pampulha Modern Ensemble
description: Pampulha is a lakeside leisure district in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, planned in 1940 around an artificial lake. Oscar Niemeyer designed its casino (now an art museum), ballroom, yacht club and the church of São Francisco de Assis, using sweeping curves and daring concrete shapes. Burle Marx's gardens and works by Brazilian artists tie the buildings and landscape together.
